definitions.explanation: Having no sense of shame; bold and unapologetic in inappropriate behavior. A literary term for shamelessness, often used in the compound {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち}.

examples.japanese: {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧

⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こして→起こす：01234_okosu⟧おいて、{厚顔|こうがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{再出馬|さいしゅつば}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧。
examples.english: After causing such a scandal, he has the audacity to run for office again.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective (also functions as noun). Uses な before nouns: {厚顔|こうがん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {厚顔|こうがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (brazenly, shamelessly)

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち} (brazen and shameless) is a common set phrase combining two synonyms for emphasis.

NUANCE: {厚顔|こうがん} is more literary and formal than ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ or ⟦{図々|ずうずう}しい→図々しい：06535_zuuzuushii⟧. It's often used in formal writing, news reports, or when criticizing public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚顔|こうがん}{無恥|むち} (brazen and shameless)
- {厚顔|こうがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (brazenly, shamelessly)
- {厚顔|こうがん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (brazen attitude)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ (impudent, shameless - more colloquial)
- ⟦{図々|ずうずう}しい→図々しい：06535_zuuzuushii⟧ (shameless, impudent)
- ⟦{恥知|はじし}らず→恥知らず：21065_hajishirazu⟧ (shameless person)
- ⟦{鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}→鉄面皮：15954_tetsumenpi⟧ (brazen-faced - literary)
